claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.restrict_action_set
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Gaseous Form forbids attacking and spellcasting while active, but the authored surface only exposes action restriction inside grant_extra_action rather than as a standalone effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Finally, the target can't attack or cast spells.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_uses_bonus_action_to_end_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The potion adds a bonus-action self-end clause that cannot be expressed with the current closed early-end trigger vocabulary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_drops_to_0_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The imported spell ends on the target at 0 Hit Points, but the current duration trigger set has no HP-threshold end condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 Hit Points...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: bypass_space_and_barrier_constraints
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Gaseous Form grants deterministic movement and occupancy exceptions that are not modeled by any current atom or attachment/window relation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_speech_and_object_interaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The form prevents speaking, manipulating objects, and interacting with carried items; this is broader than standard-action denial and is not in the current atom inventory.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with.
